## Summary
The participants discussed the upcoming release and confirmed that the build is ready. They agreed to ship the release on Friday. You will prepare the release notes by Thursday, and Others will update the website after the release. An open question was raised about announcing the release on social media.

## Decisions
- Ship the release on Friday.  

## Action items
- You: write the release notes (by Thursday).  
- Others: update the website after the release.  

## Open questions
- Do we announce it on social media?
